market_outlook.short_term: Markets face headwinds from oil-driven inflation and bond volatility. Expect continued Treasury yield pressure near 20-year highs. Equities likely choppy as bond selloff eases intermittently (as seen today). Oil above $103 sustains inflation fears. Tech/AI names provide relative strength but face valuation scrutiny. 1-3 month: range-bound with elevated volatility, oil and yields as primary drivers.
market_outlook.long_term: 6-12 month: If Iran war de-escalates, oil normalizes and inflation eases, creating re-rating opportunity for rate-sensitive sectors. AI capex cycle continues but competition (AMD vs Nvidia, SK Hynix vs Intel) pressures margins. Housing market faces structural headwind from elevated rates. EM debt attractive if global growth holds. Defense spending structurally elevated. France fiscal trajectory is key European risk.
